notes.title: 29 August 2024 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that prevented progress after Weeks 7 & 8.

A small number of players were affected by this and we are sorry that it took so much time to fix.

The problem was caused by some 2K/4K resolution monitors and did not always occur so it has taken considerable time to track down.

Thanks to all who reported bugs and submitted their logs to help solve this issue!

notes.title: Matchmaker Agency is now Available on Nintendo Switch Digital Release!
notes.notes:
[h1]August 2024 Update[/h1]
[h2]Switch Digital Release is now AVAILABLE[/h2]
We've talked about this one for a while now and we're super excited to bring you Matchmaker Agency to the Nintendo Switch. We started on PC, made our way to Steam Deck, and now we're in Nintendo territory. Right now the game is only available in Japan Nintendo e-shop and it will be available in other regions in subsequently. Charles could not be more proud. The team has been working really hard to bring you all of the love you know and worked for in PC to the Switch, so now it's time to get your controllers and dock set up. We'd love to hear your stories in the comments below! 

[h2]New Language support[/h2]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1162024557440401419.webp?size=20&quality=lossless[/img]We officially have full Japanese language support! [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1162024557440401419.webp?size=20&quality=lossless[/img]


[h3]Hotfix[/h3]
It looks like a few players have run into a situation during Week 7 where Charles decides to sit there and do nothing [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1162024555230003261.webp?size=20&quality=lossless[/img] As we continue to investigate, we've disabled the dialog for Week 7 so that players can continue in their love-matching journey.

notes.title: Major Q2 2024 Updates
notes.notes:
[h1]General Notes[/h1]

[h2]Charles was busy[/h2]
Did Charles finally go on vacation after all of his post-launch work? We'll never truly know, as he works in mysterious ways. But what we can say is that we've been very busy behind the scenes over the last few months, so we thank you for your patience and apologize for the lack of updates/news [url=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1162024557440401419.webp?size=40&quality=lossless][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1162024557440401419.webp?size=40&quality=lossless[/img][/url]

[h2]Controller support![/h2]
Yes, you read that correctly! Matchmaker now supports various controllers. Stay tuned for Steam to update their compatibility.

[h2]Steam Deck support OTW[/h2]
Our Steam deck support hasn't been at 100% since launch, but with the new controller support we can finally bring you that amazing experience! The team is super happy to say we're currently making strides in getting full Steam Deck support. Stay on the lookout for more updates.

[h2]Matchmaking on-the-go[/h2]
[url=https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44560337/bd7329a85ec8152467f89c75330edd3ce42a0238.png][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44560337/bd7329a85ec8152467f89c75330edd3ce42a0238.png[/img][/url]
Have you ever sat there wondering, in your cheap economy seats on that train from station A to B, "It would be so nice if I could just load up Matchmaker Agency and try that date again between Abby and Thomas"? Yeah, we've had those thoughts too. It'd be pretty nice if we could all just [i]touch grass[/i] and keep in touch with Charles or go to the beach and play volleyball while letting your best friend try their best to see if Miranda and Abby could ever be a match (BUT WHAT IF?!). Well, say no more. Something's coming.

[h2]Community support[/h2]
We'd also like to say that we're deeply sorry for being inactive in the Steam discussions. We've been hard at work and we'll try our best to get each and every topic that's posted.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Localization text and display issues for various languages
[*]A very long list of game bug fixes
[*]Major SFX bugs that players discovered
[/list]

notes.title: Agency Optimizations
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it's MelonCat Games here! [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1162024557440401419.webp?size=40&quality=lossless[/img]

First of all, a wonderfully big shoutout to all of the streamers and content creators who played the game in the first few weeks. We really appreciate all of your love and support and we hope that you continue to spread the word of our beautiful game. Some of you loved the game so much that you're already insisting on a sequel and we're very flattered.

Nevertheless, the team has been hard at work and we're coming to you with some big updates, sponsored by Charles. Let's break it down for you:

[list]
[*] Various storage devices had load times that were categorically slow in our team's definitions. As such, they've rolled out a massive performance update that has reduced load times by 6x the speed. That's right, everything should be much smoother and quicker to get to your dates [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1161940366610661377.gif?size=80&quality=lossless[/img]
[*] We didn't stop there! We also optimized the storage space of the game and reduced the overall size of Matchmaker Agency, giving you back every precious megabyte that you need on your storage device!
[*] Did you want to play Matchmaker Agency with a Microsoft Sidewinder or one of those off-the-shelves controllers that just come with a joystick? Well thanks to the hard work of the team, it's coming your way! Joystick support is in the pipeline and will be available in our next big update.
[/list]

That's it for now, so stay tuned for more updates to come.

Love,
Matchmaker Agency [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1161940333257568256.webp?size=40&quality=lossless[/img]

notes.title: Day 2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]General Notes[/h1]
[h2]Date Mini-game[/h2]

We've re-worked the balance of positive/neutral/negative effects of choices in the mini-game. There was logical mistakes of choices where some had positive context but negative effects, and vice-versa. We've reduced the frequency of neutral effects and mapped them according to neutral choices.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

There was an uncommon bug where the visual line can end up off-screen for players and they are unable to interact, thus blocking the workflow. This has been fixed.

We have also fixed the confusing text regarding the disabling of the interview for the week. Some text in the minigame has been fixed in this patch as well.

notes.title: Day 1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]General Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed debt bar displaying visual artifacts
[*]Fixed dialog pointers
[*]Fixed log showing empty strings
[*]Fixed random event
[*]Fixed issues where users who were reportedly spamming inputs caused inexplicable issues in the game
[/list]

[h1]Highlights[/h1]

Thanks to your feedback, there's a few game design issues that we've also addressed. We apologize for any illogical and/or puzzling moments:

- Haruka unlocks Yacht location instead of a previously, already unlocked location
- Thomas and Brian can come back after successful matches stating they weren't satisfied but the end game montage showed the original couple. There was also an issue where if Thomas matched Miranda, Miranda could also come back and say the relationship is going well (while Thomas says he wants to be matched again).
[b]In the event that Thomas and Brain only match once, we've temporarily removed them from the ending montage.[/b]

[h2]Game Logs[/h2]

Some players reported that extra game logs were being saved to the Desktop, which is located in your ~\Desktop folder. We originally used this during our beta testing to save logs and find bugs; we didn't manage to fully remove it completely in the previous build. We have removed this altogether and sincerely apologize for any confusion.

[h2]Date Mini-game[/h2]

Players have reported confusion around the rendering of the lines in the mini-game. While the upwards/downwards trend of the line rendering itself is random and not meant to display the result of your choice, the ending node and its upwards/downwards trend is indicative of the match result.
In other words, the only indicator that the match may have went well, neutral, or bad, is if the the last dot/node in the mini-game is either high on the y-axis, middle, or low on the y-axis (respectively). 

[b]The design team is working on an update mechanism to address these issues so thank you for your patience.[/b]

[b]Further analysis showed an imbalance of neutral choices versus good/bad choices and the design team will be looking to address this ASAP.[/b]

notes.title: Sneak Peek into Indonesia's Matchmaker Agency
notes.notes:
Based out of Indonesia, Niji Games and MelonCat Games present a beautifully cute and enticing story-focused matchmaking simulation game; [i]Matchmaker Agency[/i]. 

[i]Matchmaker Agency[/i] is a fresh take on the dating sim genre, where players navigate the life of a returning young adult attempting their best to re-open the family matchmaking business and pay off a long-standing debt. But you’re not alone. With the help of Charles, he will guide you along the way and teach you the basics to get on your feet and hopefully survive long enough to break free of the debt shackles. Oh, and we forgot to mention. Charles is an old black cat, a friend of the family and a familiar; a magical species of animals with hidden powers.

Presented by two members behind the game, we're very excited to give everyone a chance to explore our wonderful world as we go through a handful of Q&A items and begin the path of being a cupid.
